name: it-service-desk
description: IT Service Desk - Fullstack application with FastAPI backend and React frontend

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (test -f venv/bin/uvicorn && venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 || uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000)
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,TUNNEL,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:tunnel" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
